Flames dance upon the surface of the item you infuse with magic, eager to incinerate your foes.

Melee touch

Target: One weapon or implement

Effect: Until the end of the encounter, any attack that uses the target as a weapon or an implement deals extra fire damage equal to 1d8 + your Constitution.
